selection_basis.rule: Select at most six mechanically distinct long-only equity rules whose exact inputs are present in the pinned PIT OHLCV and corporate-action inventory; selection uses no candidate returns, NAV, Sharpe, drawdown, turnover, bootstrap, permutation, placebo, or overlay output.

corporate_action_policy.signal_basis: split-adjusted OHLCV only; dividend-adjusted prices are not signal inputs
corporate_action_policy.outcome_basis: corporate-action cash, split, and terminal treatment uses only rows with ex_date at or before the frozen cutoff
corporate_action_policy.post_cutoff_policy: corporate-action rows after 2026-07-31 are quarantined and cannot affect any claimed window
corporate_action_policy.raw_adjusted_pair: not present in the canonical equity input; no raw/adjusted mixing is permitted

selection_basis.novelty_rule: Each candidate owns a non-residual signal family and does not call V3 ranking, residual construction, V3 horizon consensus, or V3 inverse-volatility selection.

evaluation.decision: Use only completed daily bars available strictly before the decision timestamp; submit target after the completed bar and fill at the next supported NYSE regular-session open.
evaluation.signal_lag_application: For each scheduled rebalance session, compute features only through the completed bar lagged by 1, 3, or 7 supported sessions; submit the resulting target at the scheduled session boundary and fill only at the next supported NYSE regular-session open. A lag never creates a same-bar fill or overlapping target.
evaluation.rebalance_holding_policy: At each scheduled rebalance, close the prior candidate target and open at most one new target per symbol after the lagged signal is eligible; the holding interval is from fill through the next scheduled rebalance, with no duplicate overlapping target.
evaluation.missing_data: Drop a symbol for that decision when any required field, continuity, identity, or PIT eligibility check fails; do not forward-fill features, substitute OHLCV for a causal field, or convert missing data to zero return. A window with fewer than top_n valid symbols is cash.
evaluation.universe: The exact V3-compatible PIT equity universe and security/entity identity tables, excluding SPY as benchmark and excluding non-equity markets; no current-list or survivor-only expansion.
evaluation.direction_and_parameters: All directions, formulas, windows, top_n, cadence, lags, hold periods, cost multipliers, seeds, and caps below are frozen before any economic run.

trade_ledger.turnover_definition: gross traded notional divided by lagged candidate-sleeve NAV
trade_ledger.missing_or_nonfinite_policy: any missing or nonfinite ledger field blocks the affected cell; no cost or turnover is imputed

position_policy.sizing: equal weight, capped at 10% per name and renormalized within the 55% equity sleeve
position_policy.overlay_candidate_holding_limit: min(candidate_top_n, max_total_positions - dated_v3_position_count); zero when no dated spare position slot exists
position_policy.risk_policy: Use current V3 execution, regulatory fee, terminal, and risk settings for measurement; candidate may not alter V3 or product settings.

metrics: exact-date candidate/V3 selected-name overlap when dated V3 weights are present

mechanical_complementarity.measure: report exact-date selected-name overlap alongside candidate/V3 return correlation; missing dated V3 weights makes this measure unavailable and never inferred from NAV
mechanical_complementarity.selection_use: diagnostic only; no outcome-based candidate filtering

bootstrap.method: moving block on daily candidate-minus-control returns

permutation.method: within-window paired-sign permutation of candidate-minus-control daily returns

robustness.placebo: fixed +7 supported trading-session shift of the frozen signal schedule, labeled diagnostic and never used for selection

v3_overlay.recipe: 95% unchanged V3 daily NAV/dated weights + 5% candidate sleeve
v3_overlay.date_alignment: Join candidate and V3 by exact supported date; current V3 reference ends 2026-07-29, so any 2026-07-30 or 2026-07-31 overlay date without V3 state is ineligible and is never forward-filled.
v3_overlay.capacity_disposition: If dated spare capacity or V3 decision state is missing, the overlay date is ineligible; V3 return remains unchanged. No capacity is invented.

required: nonzero valid decision coverage in every claimed window
drawdown/tail, regime, turnover, bootstrap, permutation, and placebo outputs
exact V3 date alignment and candidate holding count no greater than dated spare slots

candidates.name: equity_low_realized_vol_22_v1
candidates.formula: sigma_22 = stdev(close_t/close_(t-1)-1) over the prior 22 completed sessions
candidates.universe: V3-compatible PIT equity universe, excluding SPY
candidates.rebalance: monthly at the first supported session of each month
candidates.holding: 21 sessions or until next monthly rebalance
candidates.missing_data: Require 23 aligned positive finite closes; otherwise symbol is omitted for that decision.
candidates.distinct_from_v3: Uses raw price volatility only; no market beta, residuals, 12-1 formation, horizon consensus, or inverse-residual-volatility sizing.

candidates.name: equity_short_reversal_5_v1
candidates.formula: r_5 = close_t/close_(t-5)-1 over the prior five completed sessions
candidates.universe: V3-compatible PIT equity universe, excluding SPY
candidates.rebalance: weekly at the first supported session of each week
candidates.holding: 5 sessions or until next weekly rebalance
candidates.missing_data: Require six aligned positive finite closes; otherwise symbol is omitted for that decision.
candidates.distinct_from_v3: Uses a five-session raw-return reversal direction and weekly holding; it does not use V3 residual momentum or its 21-session skip.

candidates.name: equity_volume_surprise_20x60_v1
candidates.formula: VS = median(close*volume over prior 20 sessions) / median(close*volume over prior 60 sessions)
candidates.universe: V3-compatible PIT equity universe, excluding SPY
candidates.rebalance: monthly at the first supported session of each month
candidates.holding: 21 sessions or until next monthly rebalance
candidates.missing_data: Require 60 aligned finite strictly positive volume and positive close observations; zero-volume bars are missing for this signal and the denominator must remain positive; otherwise symbol is omitted for that decision.
candidates.distinct_from_v3: Ranks a volume/liquidity shock from OHLCV and has no return, beta, residual, or V3 rank input. It is measured as an alpha candidate, not a liquidity control.

candidates.name: equity_log_price_slope_126_v1
candidates.formula: beta_126 = OLS slope of log(close) on session index over the prior 126 completed sessions
candidates.universe: V3-compatible PIT equity universe, excluding SPY
candidates.rebalance: monthly at the first supported session of each month
candidates.holding: 21 sessions or until next monthly rebalance
candidates.missing_data: Require 126 aligned positive finite closes and finite nonzero design variance; otherwise symbol is omitted for that decision.
candidates.distinct_from_v3: Uses a single-name time-series log-price slope; no cross-sectional residualization, beta hedge, skip window, or multi-horizon V3 consensus.

candidates.name: equity_52w_breakout_distance_252_v1
candidates.formula: BD = close_t / max(high over prior 252 completed sessions) - 1
candidates.universe: V3-compatible PIT equity universe, excluding SPY
candidates.rebalance: monthly at the first supported session of each month
candidates.holding: 21 sessions or until next monthly rebalance
candidates.missing_data: Require 252 aligned finite highs and positive close; otherwise symbol is omitted for that decision.
candidates.distinct_from_v3: Uses distance from a trailing raw-price high and no residual return, beta, 12-1 formation, skip, or consensus score.

candidates.name: equity_range_efficiency_20_v1
candidates.formula: ER = abs(close_t-close_(t-20)) / sum(abs(close_i-close_(i-1))) over the prior 20 completed sessions
candidates.universe: V3-compatible PIT equity universe, excluding SPY
candidates.rebalance: monthly at the first supported session of each month
candidates.holding: 21 sessions or until next monthly rebalance
candidates.missing_data: Require 21 aligned positive finite closes and positive path denominator; otherwise symbol is omitted for that decision.
candidates.distinct_from_v3: Ranks path efficiency rather than residual magnitude or volatility; its denominator and 20-session horizon are fixed independently of V3.
